freeAI.custom.providers.markdownDescription: Your own OpenAI-compatible endpoints (Ollama, LM Studio, llama.cpp, vLLM, OpenRouter, a gateway). Easiest to manage on the **AI Free VSCode — Open Settings** page. API keys are never stored here — they live in SecretStorage.

id.description: Stable slug. Part of the model ids and of the key entry in SecretStorage; generated from the name when omitted.

name.description: Display name in the model picker.

baseUrl.description: Base URL including the version segment, e.g. http://localhost:1234/v1

noApiKey.description: The endpoint needs no API key (typical for local servers).

models.description: Explicit model list. When empty, the models come from GET {baseUrl}/models.

toolCalling.description: The endpoint supports the OpenAI tools API (needed for agent mode).

headers.description: Extra request headers, e.g. HTTP-Referer for OpenRouter.

freeAI.debug.markdownDescription: Verbose DEBUG logs in the 'AI Free VSCode' output channel (auth flow, requests, streaming, raw model output). To report a problem: turn this on, reproduce it, then run **AI Free VSCode — Copy Debug Report** and paste the result into a GitHub issue. Tokens, cookies and e-mails are masked.

freeAI.commit.enabled.description: Show the ✨ commit message button in the Source Control view.

freeAI.commit.model.markdownDescription: Model for commit messages. `auto` = first available.

freeAI.commit.prompt.default:
Generate a commit message for the git diff below.
Requirements:
- Use Conventional Commits format: type(scope): summary (type = feat|fix|docs|style|refactor|perf|test|build|ci|chore).
- Subject on a single line, imperative mood, max 72 characters.
- Write the message in English.
- For significant changes, add a short body after a blank line (a bullet list is allowed).
- Reply with ONLY the commit message text: no markdown fences, no quotes, no explanations.
freeAI.commit.prompt.markdownDescription: Instruction for commit message generation; the git diff is appended to it automatically.

freeAI.suggestions.enabled.markdownDescription: On-demand ghost-text suggestions. Never appear while typing — trigger them with `Ctrl/Cmd+Alt+\`.

freeAI.suggestions.model.markdownDescription: Model for inline suggestions. `auto` = first available.

freeAI.suggestions.maxPrefixChars.description: Characters of code before the cursor sent to the model.

freeAI.suggestions.maxSuffixChars.description: Characters of code after the cursor sent to the model.

freeAI.fix.enabled.description: Show 'Fix with AI Free' in the Quick Fix lightbulb (⌘./Ctrl+.) on errors and warnings.

freeAI.fix.model.markdownDescription: Model for fixing problems. `auto` = first available.

enumDescriptions: Try a hidden headless browser first, and automatically fall back to a minimized visible window only if the Qwen anti-bot blocks it (recommended)
Always use a real (minimized) browser window — most reliable against the anti-bot, but a window is created
Always headless with no window and no fallback — no window ever, but the anti-bot may block requests
freeAI.qwen.browserMode.markdownDescription: How the Qwen anti-bot (WAF) fallback browser runs. Changing this needs a window reload.

enumDescriptions: Try a hidden headless browser first, and automatically fall back to a minimized visible window only if the Z.ai anti-bot blocks it (recommended)
Always use a real (minimized) browser window — most reliable against the anti-bot, but a window is created
Always headless with no window and no fallback — no window ever, but the anti-bot may block requests
freeAI.zai.browserMode.markdownDescription: How the Z.ai anti-bot (WAF) bridge browser runs. Changing this needs a window reload.

freeAI.proxy.markdownDescription: Proxy for the browser windows the extension opens (sign-in, the Qwen and Z.ai bridges): `http://host:port`, `http://user:pass@host:port` or `socks5://host:port`. Empty uses VS Code's `#http.proxy#`. Requests made directly by the extension always follow `#http.proxy#`, so setting only that covers everything. Takes effect for newly opened browser windows (reload the window to apply to a running bridge).
